subject: C Q-SPEAR pipeline published no contract impact
body:

- Ports/arithmetic/vectors unchanged; only per-op cycle count grows (S10.7 RTL_PIPELINE_DEPTH = IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED).
- prof_active_id_max / ID_OUT_OF_ACTIVE_RANGE (A-ID-PROFILE-01) unchanged; 32-bit semantic ID kept.
- OOC 100 MHz xc7a100t: qstar_select WNS +1.703, spear_rank WNS +1.898 (post-synth estimate only; D re-synths fabric).
- Hashes/bag: rtl/native_ai/strategy/QSTAR_SPEAR_OOC_PIPE.json (worktree commit 7b13f64).
Also republished ref/learning/{qstar,spear}_ref.py + gen_* (C-CODE-07 versions) that the previous PACKAGE publish missed.
NOT_CLAIMED: TIMING_PASS VERIFIED BOARD_PASS.
